test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A % B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A # B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P & Q % R # S @ T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 %
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Mother
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

Given: P & Q % R # S @ T

P & Q → P is the father of Q.

Q % R → Q is the mother of R.

R # S → R is the brother of S.​

S @ T → S is the wife of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f19b6f7ac7ab12e31998832dda95297eee1b9f7972670c1604688a5db3fcc669.png] 

Here, P is the wife’s mother’s father of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
